US.description: Covers groceries, utilities, transportation, and miscellaneous personal expenses for an average US city.

IN.description: Covers groceries, local transportation, utilities, and moderate entertainment/leisure for a comfortable individual lifestyle.

SG.description: Singapore has a high cost of living, particularly for housing and private transportation. Groceries, public transport, and local food (hawker centers) are relatively more affordable.

CH.description: Groceries, transportation, utilities, and personal expenses are significantly higher than many other developed nations.

NL.description: Moderate cost for groceries, utilities, and public transport; higher for dining out and leisure activities in major cities.

GB.description: Cost of living is moderately high, particularly for groceries, utilities, and transport. This index excludes rent.

CA.description: Cost of living covers essential expenses like groceries, public transportation, utilities, and basic entertainment for a single individual, excluding rent.

AE.description: Cost of living, excluding rent, is moderately high due to expenses like groceries, dining, and utilities, particularly in major cities.

NO.description: High cost for groceries, transportation, and dining, reflecting generally high prices in Norway.

IE.description: Covers groceries, public transportation, utilities, dining, and personal care items.

LU.description: Groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure activities are significantly more expensive than average, reflecting a high-income economy with robust social services.

AU.description: High costs for groceries, dining out, public transportation, and utilities in major cities.

QA.description: High cost of living, particularly for groceries, dining out, and utilities; transport is relatively affordable due to low fuel costs.

BN.description: The cost of living excluding rent is generally moderate, with local food and transportation being affordable, while imported goods can be more expensive.

MO.description: Cost of living for a single person in Macao SAR, covering groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure, excluding rent. Prices are generally high due to imports and limited local production.
